title: Devices silent for a long period are still present

longStaleDays.text: Days after which a device is almost certainly gone

report.title: {Items.Count} {Plural(Items.Count, 'device has', 'devices have')} been silent for more than {params.longStaleDays} days

messages.businessImpact: These records distort every count in every report, including the ones used to judge compliance and licensing.
remediation: Retire the devices, or enable a cleanup rule with a threshold that matches how the organisation actually works.
messages.cannotSee: Whether a silent device has been decommissioned or is simply switched off is not visible. Intune's own cleanup rule may already be set to remove them, which HYG-001 asks about, so a finding here can be one the tenant has already answered.
